<section class="section about-section" id="about"><div class="container about-grid">
<div class="about-copy reveal"><span class="eyebrow">About MUSA</span><h2>Built around opportunities Connected through relationships</h2>
<p><strong>MUSA Real Estate Community</strong> brings together acquisition research and investor relations to create a more focused way to discuss real estate opportunities.</p>
<p>Our acquisition team focuses on identifying and researching potential properties, understanding market conditions, and supporting seller-side outreach. Investor relations focuses on understanding buyer criteria, presenting available property information, and coordinating conversations around potential opportunities.</p>
<div class="about-pull">“The right opportunity starts with understanding what the investor is actually looking for.”</div>

<section class="section process-section" id="process"><div class="container">
<div class="section-head reveal"><span class="eyebrow">How we work</span><h2>A clear path from acquisition research to investor review</h2><p>Different responsibilities work together to keep property conversations organized and investor-focused.</p></div>
<figure class="process-visual reveal"><img alt="Four-step process infographic: market research and acquisition, property evaluation, investor alignment, and deal coordination" loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><figcaption>Four-stage overview — expanded explanations follow below</figcaption></figure>
<div class="process-grid">
<article class="process-step reveal"><span class="step-no">01</span><h3>Market Research &amp; Acquisition</h3><p>The acquisition team researches target markets, explores property opportunities, and supports seller-side outreach.</p></article>
<article class="process-step reveal"><span class="step-no">02</span><h3>Property Evaluation</h3><p>Available property details, condition, comparable information, and open questions are organized for review.</p></article>
<article class="process-step reveal"><span class="step-no">03</span><h3>Investor Alignment</h3><p>Buyer criteria, target markets, strategy, and purchasing preferences help guide relevant conversations.</p></article>
<article class="process-step reveal"><span class="step-no">04</span><h3>Deal Coordination</h3><p>Interested buyers receive available information and coordinate next steps, verification, and due diligence.</p></article>
</div>
<p class="process-caption">Investors should independently verify all property details, financial assumptions, title matters, and transaction terms before proceeding.</p>
</div></section>

<section class="section strategy-section" id="strategies"><div class="container">
<div class="section-head reveal"><span class="eyebrow">What we look for</span><h2>Different strategies Different buy boxes</h2><p>Investment criteria change with the property, the market, the buyer's plan, and the capital structure.</p></div>
<div class="strategy-grid">
<article class="strategy-card reveal"><div class="strategy-icon">↗</div><h3>Fix &amp; Flip</h3><p>Purchase opportunities where condition, renovation scope, resale assumptions, and exit strategy can be evaluated.</p></article>
<article class="strategy-card reveal"><div class="strategy-icon">⌂</div><h3>Buy &amp; Hold</h3><p>Properties considered around long-term ownership goals, location preferences, and the investor's acquisition criteria.</p></article>
<article class="strategy-card reveal"><div class="strategy-icon">▤</div><h3>Rental Property</h3><p>Rental-focused opportunities where occupancy, income assumptions, operating expenses, and property condition matter.</p></article>
<article class="strategy-card reveal"><div class="strategy-icon">▦</div><h3>Multifamily</h3><p>Multi-unit residential properties reviewed around unit mix, available operating details, and investor requirements.</p></article>
<article class="strategy-card reveal"><div class="strategy-icon">◇</div><h3>Value-Add</h3><p>Properties where improvements or repositioning may be considered after careful review of cost and market context.</p></article>

<script>
(() => {
  const menuButton = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  const nav = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  menuButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    menuButton.textContent = open ? '×' : '☰';
  });
  nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', () => {
    nav.classList.remove('open'); menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); menuButton.textContent='☰';
  }));

  const filters = document.querySelectorAll('#profileFilters .filter-btn');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-card');
  filters.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    filters.forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('active'); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
    button.classList.add('active'); button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
    const filter = button.dataset.filter;
    cards.forEach(card => { card.hidden = filter !== 'all' && card.dataset.category !== filter; });
  }));
  const portfolioPanels = {profiles:document.getElementById('profilesView'),current:document.getElementById('currentView'),closed:document.getElementById('closedView'),cases:document.getElementById('casesView')};
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('active'); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
    button.classList.add('active'); button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
    Object.entries(portfolioPanels).forEach(([name,panel]) => { panel.hidden = name !== button.dataset.view; });
  }));

  let selectedApproach = 'Cash Purchase';
  document.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn').forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('active'); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
    button.classList.add('active'); button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true'); selectedApproach = button.dataset.approach;
  }));
  document.getElementById('addMarket').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const state = document.getElementById('marketState').value.trim();
    const city = document.getElementById('marketCity').value.trim();
    const status = document.getElementById('formStatus');
    if (!state && !city) { status.textContent = 'Select a state or enter a city / ZIP code first.'; document.getElementById('marketState').focus(); return; }
    const location = [city, state].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    const entry = `${location} — ${selectedApproach}`;
    const field = document.getElementById('targetMarkets');
    const current = field.value.split('\n').map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!current.includes(entry)) current.push(entry);
    field.value = current.join('\n');
    status.textContent = 'Market added to your Buy Box. You can add another market or complete the form.';
    document.getElementById('buybox').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  });

  const form = document.getElementById('buyboxForm');
  form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const rows = [];
    for (const [key,value] of data.entries()) rows.push(`${key}: ${String(value).trim()}`);
    const subject = 'MUSA Investor Buy Box — ' + (data.get('Full name') || 'New Investor Inquiry');
    const body = [
      'Hello Amaila,', '',
      'I would like to share my investor buy box with MUSA Real Estate Community.', '',
      ...rows, '',
      'Please contact me to discuss relevant opportunities and next steps.'
    ].join('\n');
    const mailto = 'mailto:amailaabrooks@gmail.com?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);
    document.getElementById('formStatus').textContent = 'Your email app should open with your Buy Box details. Press Send in your email app to submit them.';
    window.location.href = mailto;
  });

  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  const observer = ('IntersectionObserver' in window) ? new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); } });
  }, {threshold:.12}) : null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => { if (observer) observer.observe(el); else el.classList.add('visible'); });
})();
</script>
